'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Thomas Whaley LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
